liam: morning all, first day here! browser okta login worked but Okta Verify installer fails in WSL2 Ubuntu with "unsupported environment". need access to eng/onboarding drive and my 1Password invite also expired. who do i ping? :wave:

it-support: welcome @liam! :tada: we can resend your 1Password invite, add you to a temporary new-hires vault, or enable Okta email as a short-lived factor. tagging @samir for WSL auth workarounds and @kyra for invites/shipping.

samir: hey @liam 30 WSL won't run mobile apps like Okta Verify. options:
- use 1Password TOTP on a phone or 1Password CLI in WSL
- enable Okta Email/SMS temporarily
- request a YubiKey shipped to you
Which do you prefer?

liam: i'd like to use 1Password CLI from WSL since i do dev there. resend the invite please. also need access to shared folder eng/onboarding.

it-support: invite resent. I also granted you a temp new-hires vault with Drive links and repo creds for 6 hours. check email. if the invite still errors reply here.

okta-bot: Note: Device trust enforcement is limited to managed macOS/iOS/Android. Browser sessions from WSL are considered unmanaged. For hardware key enrollment file an IT ticket with shipping address.

samir: quick 1Password CLI steps for WSL:
1) sign into 1Password desktop on Windows so the account is discoverable
2) install op in WSL (deb):
```
curl -sS https://downloads.1password.com/linux/keys/1password.asc | sudo apt-key add -
echo "deb [arch=amd64] https://downloads.1password.com/linux/debian stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/1password.list
sudo apt update && sudo apt install 1password-cli
```
3) run `op signin --account redwood` in WSL, open the URL on Windows if it doesn't auto-open, paste the token back into WSL.
4) get OTP: `op item get "Okta" --otp`
If you want headless tokens for CI we can create a limited service key.

liam: thanks, followed steps and op returned OTP so i could finish Okta email factor. invite link still said invalid earlier but temp vault had what i needed.

kyra: hi @liam 30 please DM me your preferred phone for 2FA and whether you want a YubiKey shipped (yes/no + address). i'll also flag for a permanent 1Password seat if you need it sooner.

it-support: note 30 for git/ssh in WSL copy your SSH keys into WSL or use Windows ssh-agent with op. happy to screenshare.

liam: DM'd my phone and address. will start with CLI for now and let you know if i want a YubiKey shipped. thanks everyone, marking resolved after YubiKey decision. :white_check_mark:

samir: leaving device-enroll relaxed on your account for 24h to let setup finish. re-open if anything breaks. :thumbsup:
